khalid-wallet: completed against the finops lane. The run showed a real anomaly — 0 took three passes because the first two attempts failed on auth. Root cause was a stale token; rotated and re-ran, then the receipt verified clean on the second try. Logged the incident, no phantom rows.

credit-gift — finops round. 2 was the bottleneck: prefill-bound at 17K tokens, so the whole finops pipeline waited ~3 minutes before the model even started. Trimmed the prompt shell to the minimal surface; time-to-first-response dropped to seconds. The delta is in the receipts. This is the compounding case in practice.
